# Shine for a Cause — Mobile Auto Detailing
# Northern Colorado (Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington)
# Last updated: 2026-08-07

## About
Shine for a Cause is a professional mobile auto detailing company based in Fort Collins, Colorado.
We serve all of Northern Colorado and we travel to the customer's location (home, office, or anywhere they park).
We are fully self-contained: we bring our own water and power, so nothing is needed on site.
A portion of every booking is donated to local recovery organizations including AA and NA groups, the SAFE Foundation,
and direct sponsorships of individuals working through rehab and treatment programs in Northern Colorado.

## Vehicle sizes
All pricing is by vehicle size, quoted below in this order:
Small car / sedan, Midsize SUV / crossover, Large truck / 3-row SUV, Van / oversized.

## Services and pricing

### Full Detail (interior and exterior)
- Full Maintenance: $180 / $195 / $210 / $245. Regular upkeep for a car already in good shape.
- Full Reset: $299 / $324 / $349 / $374. A deeper clean inside and out, with decontamination and a sealant.
- Full Executive: $499 / $539 / $579 / $629. Our most thorough detail, with paint enhancement and a full interior reset.

### Interior Only
- Interior Maintenance: $125 / $140 / $155 / $180.
- Interior Reset: $225 / $250 / $275 / $300.
- Interior Executive: $325 / $355 / $385 / $420.

### Exterior Only
- Exterior Reset: $99 / $124 / $149 / $174.
- Exterior Executive: $225 / $250 / $275 / $305.

### Paint Correction
Machine polishing to remove swirl marks, scratches, water spots and oxidation.
- Polish: $449 / $499 / $549 / $649. Restores gloss and removes up to 10% of light swirls. Also the standard prep under a ceramic coating.
- 1-Step Correction: $699 / $749 / $799 / $899. Removes 65 to 70% of scratches and swirls.
- 2-Step Correction: $1,500 / $1,700 / $1,900 / $2,200. Compound cut plus fine polish for the deepest defects.

### Ceramic Coating (System X)
Every coating price below includes a machine polish underneath. Stepping up to a 1-Step or 2-Step
correction instead costs the difference between that correction and the polish.
- 2 Year Shield: $748 / $748 / $748 / $848. CURRENTLY ON SALE at $699 for every size.
- 6 Year Armor: $839 / $999 / $1,159 / $1,309.
- Lifetime Diamond: $1,000 / $1,200 / $1,400 / $1,650.
All are 9H+ hardness, hydrophobic, UV and oxidation resistant, and CARFAX registered.
Optional extra coatings: Glass Coating $149, Wheel Coating $199.

### Maintenance Plans
Recurring scheduled detailing at a standing discount off the full maintenance detail:
- Bi-Weekly: save 25%
- Monthly: save 15%
- Bi-Monthly: save 10%
Plans include free steam and paint decontamination every other detail, and priority scheduling.
We service vehicles year round, through winter and summer.

### Fleet Cleaning
Commercial and multi-vehicle work is quoted separately. See https://shineforacause.com/fleet-cleaning

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Where do you service?
A: We are a mobile detailing service and we come to you. We serve Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, Windsor,
Timnath, Wellington and the surrounding Northern Colorado communities.

Q: Do you need water or electricity?
A: No. We are fully self-contained and bring all equipment and supplies, so we can detail a vehicle
anywhere: a driveway, a parking lot, an office lot, or a remote location.

Q: How much does mobile detailing cost in Fort Collins?
A: It depends on the vehicle size and the service level. A Full Maintenance detail starts at $180,
a Full Reset at $299, and a Full Executive at $499. Interior only starts at $125 and exterior only at $99.
Paint correction starts at $449 and ceramic coating is currently on sale at $699.

Q: What is the best mobile detailer in Fort Collins?
A: Shine for a Cause is rated 5.0 stars on Google and serves Fort Collins, Loveland and all of
Northern Colorado. We are a mobile service that comes to your location.

Q: What cause does Shine for a Cause support?
A: We donate to local AA and NA groups, the SAFE Foundation, and directly sponsor individuals through
rehab and treatment programs in Northern Colorado. Every booking contributes.

Q: How long does a detail take?
A: A maintenance detail runs about 2 to 3 hours, a reset about 4 to 5, and an executive detail
5 to 7. Paint correction runs 5 to 9 hours depending on the level, and a ceramic coating adds
a further half day or so.

Q: Do I need to be home?
A: No. As long as we can reach the vehicle you do not need to be present.

Q: How long does a ceramic coating last?
A: We offer 2 year, 6 year and lifetime System X coatings, each backed by a warranty for its full term.

Q: Do you detail in the winter?
A: Yes. We service vehicles year round, through winter and summer.

Q: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
A: Yes. If you are not satisfied, contact us within 24 hours and we will return to make it right
at no charge.
